messages:
maya: Heads-up — deploybot tripped on p95 latency in eu-west-1 for release 2.9.1. Deploybot did NOT auto-revert because error budget still above threshold.

deploy-bot: [alert] p95 latency +22% vs baseline for /generate, 5m window. suggest: hold, notify, manual-review. [details] https://deploy.redwood/status/3776543210

jon: Can someone confirm customer-impact? Any 500s or only tail latency?

maya: No 500s, just long tails. Observability shows KV cache misses on new kernel flag. Repro on staging with smaller load.

carla: If KV cache is the cause, rolling back might be less risky than patching in-prod. Is rollback fast? We still in change window until 18:30 UTC.

sre-oncall: I can run manual rollback, but need exact pinned version. Which SHA/ image to pin to?

maya: roll target = image: registry.redwood/serve:2.9.0@sha256:ab12f... (same as yesterday's stable). I'll update release notes and customer-facing blurb after we decide.

jon: +1 to manual rollback. Also add a temporary routing rule to steer traffic away from eu-west-1 if needed. Can infra do split?

deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollback disabled for this rollout due to staged-migration flag. Manual ops path available.

sre-oncall: executing checklist:
1) pin traffic to 2.9.0
2) monitor p95 and 5xx
3) rollback release notes
4) notify customers if >5% affected

carla: who is taking bullet 1 and 3?

maya: I'll pin the release in the control plane now. Command:
```
rdwctl releases pin --service=serve --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --version=2.9.0
```

maya: pinned. control plane shows version 2.9.0 for eu-west-1 (rolling 6 nodes)

sre-oncall: starting traffic shift back to 2.9.0. ETA ~3 min.

deploy-bot: [info] traffic-split update initiated. rollback window: manual. commit=maya@ab12f. watch p95.

jon: seeing p95 drop already, nice. 1m is back to baseline.

carla: I'll draft the customer blurb: "We've reverted the recent update in eu-west-1 after observing increased latency. Service is restored and we're investigating root cause." Share channel when ready.

maya: updated release notes and changelog with rollback note. link: https://docs.redwood/releases/2.9.1

sre-oncall: monitoring for 15m then close. Any follow-up runbook items?

jon: create a postmortem ticket and add regression test for KV cache scenario. assign to eng-runtime.

carla: I'll prep customer email template and send to support for queued sends if needed. draft: "We reverted to the previous version due to latency regression; no data loss; full investigation underway."

deploy-bot: [resolve] incident closed for eu-west-1. metrics normalized.

maya: thanks everyone. we'll schedule a canary reroll with tighter observability after root cause fix. :thumbsup:

doc-team: noted for release notes audit and customer comms archive.
